intent: TEST for R2dbcTelemetryRecordRepository. Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ tests (StepVerifier for reactive types, Mockito for collaborators, WebTestClient for controllers) asserting ONLY the ast_hints API and the invariants below; cover happy paths, boundaries and error cases. Context: Telemetry Record Ledger, infrastructure adapter. Implements TelemetryRecordRepository with Spring's R2DBC DatabaseClient; constructor R2dbcTelemetryRecordRepository(DatabaseClient databaseClient). Table telemetry.telemetry_record_revisions created by the Flyway migration V2 (db/migrations/V2__telemetry_record_revisions.sql): read its column names/types and map the entity (TelemetryRecordRevision <-> row) to them exactly, including enum-to-text and Instant conversion. SQL must be portable between PostgreSQL 16 and H2 in PostgreSQL mode. Insert-only: no UPDATE or DELETE statements exist. latestRevisionNumber uses MAX(revision) with COALESCE to 0; findLatestInRange selects the highest revision per (device_id, metric_type, t_device) within [from, to] ordered by t_device. Unique-constraint violations surface as the original error. Non-blocking; tested against in-process H2 with Flyway migrations applied.

methods.signature: Mono<Integer> latestRevisionNumber(String deviceId, TelemetryContracts.MetricType metricType, Instant tDevice)
Flux<TelemetryRecordRevision> findHistory(String deviceId, TelemetryContracts.MetricType metricType, Instant tDevice)
